title: Mall Atrium Reference Series
description: One two-story mall atrium re-photographed across four states: after-close overview, escalator frozen mid-step, central fountain off, and skylight at night. All must read as the same atrium.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes atrium footprint, balcony layout, escalator position, fountain basin, and camera vantage. Images 02-04 depend on 01 as --ref and re-stage the same atrium under different partial-state conditions while keeping tile pattern, balcony railings, and camera viewpoint identical.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
